title: Create Aeronautics Paddlewheels
description: Allows waterwheels to be used as paddlewheels for boats
body:
Allows for waterwheels to be used as paddlewheels of physics contraptions.\
\
Complete with a config for tweaking small and large waterwheel thrust, as well as what rpm is the max thrust for the wheels.\
\
